svg.title: Bulk Credential Issuance Queue Flow
svg.desc: End-to-end flow from CSV upload through validation, IPFS metadata, BullMQ, async workers, rate-limited dispatch, SSE progress, and completion.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What CSV format is expected for bulk credential issuance?')
sendPrompt('What does the Express API Gateway do in this flow?')
sendPrompt('What validations are run on the CSV?')
sendPrompt('What metadata is pinned to IPFS via Pinata?')
sendPrompt('How does BullMQ manage the credential issuance jobs?')
sendPrompt('How do the async background workers process rows?')
sendPrompt('How is the Resend rate limit enforced at 10/sec?')
sendPrompt('How does the SSE endpoint stream live progress to the client?')
sendPrompt('What does the completion step show the user?')
